query: With --enable-dynamic-vram on ROCm/Windows (RX 7900 XT), MiniMaxH3 INT4 convrot_w4a4 quantized model outputs a completely gray image (0.4.11 runs 10 steps in <1s, 0.4.13 computes but still gray), and the GGUF build of the same arch fills VRAM and hangs before step 1. Low-level HostBuffer->VBAR roundtrip verified OK; suspect QuantizedTensor geometry handling in ModelPatcherDynamic.load and detour-hook interference with the legacy load path.

desired.outcome: No confirmed fix. Maintainer 0xDELUXA could not reproduce on RDNA4/Windows ROCm 10.1 + torch 2.14, asked OP to retest, and suggested W4A8 or int8_convrot are better quantization choices than GGUF/W4A4 (comment, unconfirmed by OP).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
